description: This PHP class ClaimService manages claim-related operations in the OrangeHRM system, including generating reference IDs and accessing the ClaimDao data access object.

classes.name: ClaimService
classes.description: Service class providing claim-related functionality, utilizing data access and date-time helper traits.

methods.name: getClaimDao
methods.description: Initializes and returns the ClaimDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Generates a unique reference ID based on the current date and next claim ID.
